parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the app to which the channel to be recorded belongs. The app must belong to the primary account associated with the current API caller's account.

parameters.name: ChannelId
parameters.description: The ID of the channel to be recorded. Make sure that the channel has active users when you call this operation. Otherwise, the recording task fails to be created.

parameters.name: MaxIdleTime
parameters.description: The idle timeout period. When the task remains idle for longer than MaxIdleTime, the task is automatically stopped. Unit: seconds. The value must be within [10,14400], which is a maximum of 4 hours. Default value: 300.

parameters.name: MixLayoutParams
parameters.description: The layout parameters. This parameter is not required in single-stream recording mode and is required in stream mixing recording mode when the output is not audio-only.

parameters.name: MixTranscodeParams
parameters.description: The transcoding parameters. This parameter is not required in single-stream recording mode and is required in stream mixing recording mode.

parameters.name: NotifyAuthKey
parameters.description: The authentication key for callback messages. Leave this parameter empty to skip authentication. If specified, the key must be 16 to 64 characters in length and consist of only uppercase and lowercase letters and digits.

parameters.name: NotifyFileUploadedFormat
parameters.description: The specified formats for which a callback message is sent when the recording file upload event (RecordFileUploaded) is triggered.

parameters.name: NotifyUrl
parameters.description: The URL for receiving callback messages. Task status messages are pushed to this URL in JSON format by using the POST method. The maximum length is 2048 characters.
